response.answer: Deep Koopman predictive control, stability enforcement, and real-time deployment are enhanced by advances in digital twins and optimization, with a focus on soft robotics and differentiable predictive control. Cloud-assisted nonlinear model predictive control is also prominent in autonomous systems.
